text: Lately I keep imagining driving off the bridge on the way to the pediatrician.
I feel like I can't get a full breath, even sitting on the couch.
Sharp pain in my chest when I breathe in, started this morning.
I fainted while holding the baby this morning, my partner caught us.
The bleeding got heavy again and I filled a pad in under an hour.
This headache has lasted since Sunday, and meds and water haven't helped at all.
My eyes keep going blurry and I saw bright flashes this afternoon.
My left leg is swollen and red and it hurts to put weight on it.
Baby did tummy time today and I finally ate a hot meal.
I'm so sleepy, took a nap when he napped, and felt a bit more human after.
Teared up at his newborn photos, it's going by so quickly.
Still spotting a little and using light pads, otherwise a calm day.
My boobs were engorged this morning but pumping helped.
I got annoyed at my partner about the dishes and we talked it out.
Kind of anxious about going back to work next month.
My shoulders are stiff from nursing in a bad position.
